Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk

Record Class PerkTier

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk.PerkTier
Record Components:
id - the tier's key in perks.yml
displayName - the name shown to players, with its color codes
permission - the node that puts a player in the tier
priority - higher wins when a player holds several tiers' permissions
numbers - the Perk.Type.NUMBER perks the tier sets
toggles - the Perk.Type.TOGGLE perks the tier sets
public record PerkTier(@NotNull String id, @NotNull String displayName, @NotNull String permission, int priority, @NotNull Map<Perk,Integer> numbers, @NotNull Map<Perk,Boolean> toggles) extends Record
One named tier of perks.yml, such as vip. A snapshot.

A player belongs to the enabled tier with the highest priority whose permission they hold. A perk the tier does not set follows the server-wide default.

Since:
1.9.0
